start.name_en: Leitang Distribution Station (built for Sinopec's Guangxi LNG project pipeline)
start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '黎塘镇' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E9%BB%8E%E5%A1%98%E9%95%87) -- returned the Leitang town place node (Binyang County, Nanning, Guangxi), a town-level anchor since the station's exact plot is not separately mapped in OSM.

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '宾阳镇,宾阳县' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E5%AE%BE%E9%98%B3%E9%95%87%2C%E5%AE%BE%E9%98%B3%E5%8E%BF) -- returned the Binyang County government office as a county-seat anchor. The source pins the station more precisely as northeast of 塘表村 (Tangbiao village), but that village name returned no match in Nominatim (only same-named villages in Guangdong/Qinzhou, wrong location) -- so this is a county-seat-level fallback, coarser than the source's own village-level description.

corridor_notes: Two government-mandated post-construction environmental filings by Guangxi Gas Group (2025-07-30 completion disclosure and 2026-07-23 final acceptance report, both on yanshougs.com) state verbatim: '出自中石化广西液化天然气（LNG）项目输气管道已建的黎塘分输站' (originates from the existing Leitang distribution station, built for Sinopec's Guangxi LNG project pipeline) and '终于位于宾阳县塘表村东北侧的宾阳分输站' (terminates at the Binyang distribution station, northeast of Tangbiao village, Binyang County). Route runs westward from Leitang through four townships: 黎塘镇 (Leitang), 洋桥镇 (Yangqiao), 王灵镇 (Wangling), 大桥镇 (Daqiao) -- all within Binyang County, Nanning. As-built length 23.9196-23.925 km (the two filings differ slightly), D273.1mm pipe, 4MPa design pressure, design throughput 2.91e8 Nm3/a (0.291 bcm/y) -- Diameter, Pressure and Capacity all exact matches to GEM's recorded values; Length is ~3km/~11% shorter than GEM's current 27km (reads as pre-construction estimate vs as-built, flagged by the pilot pass, not corrected here).
researcher_notes: Confirms and extends the prior pass's findings exactly -- both yanshougs.com URLs re-verified OK via url_verifier this pass. Township order along the route (west from Leitang): Leitang -> Yangqiao -> Wangling -> Daqiao -> Binyang distribution station near Tangbiao village. No duplicate found elsewhere in the Guangxi roster referencing these place names.
blockers: Village-level precision for the Binyang end (塘表村/Tangbiao) could not be geocoded via Nominatim -- coordinates fall back to the Binyang county-seat point, coarser than the sourced description.
